info.title: ImageGenCli
info.description: Multi-provider image generation CLI supporting Gemini, OpenAI, BFL FLUX, and Poe

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate images using Gemini, OpenAI, BFL (FLUX), or Poe image models

options.name: --provider
options.description: Provider: gemini, openai, bfl, or poe [default: gemini]

options.name: --system-prompt
options.description: Optional system instruction for the model (Gemini only)

options.name: --resolution
options.description: Output resolution: 1K, 2K, 4K (Gemini Pro/3.1 Flash, BFL, some Poe models); WxH or aspect ratio for OpenAI gpt-image-2 [default: 1K]

options.name: --quality
options.description: Quality level: low, medium, high (OpenAI, Poe)

options.name: --model
options.description: Model name (use --list-models to see available models per provider)

options.name: --samples
options.description: Number of images to generate (1-4 for Gemini, 1-10 for OpenAI) [default: 1]

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key (or set GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / BFL_API_KEY / POE_API_KEY env var)

options.name: --list-models
options.description: List available models for the specified provider [default: False]

arguments.name: PROMPT
arguments.description: The text prompt for image generation [default: ]
